name: 19. Chat-to-Responses Tool Replay (#5101 / PR #5102) (chat-responses-tool-replay)
description: Regression coverage for PR #5102 (closes #5101): Vercel-AI-SDK-style clients replay an assistant tool call and its tool result on the second step of a run. When the compat plugin converts /v1/chat/completions to the OpenAI Responses API, the replayed tool call becomes a function_call input item that must NOT carry role - OpenAI rejects role on any non-message input item with 400 unknown_parameter input[N].role. Cases 1-2 drive the real conversion route (x-bf-compat forces convert_chat_to_responses); case 3 pins the wire invariant on the native /v1/responses route with a caller-supplied role-bearing function_call item. Cases 4-5 pin that a chat tool message with array content converts to function_call_output blocks in the Responses spelling (input_text, not the chat text type), which OpenAI and Azure rejected with "Invalid value: 'text'. Supported values are: 'input_text', ..." at input[N].output[0].type. Cases 6-8 pin that a chat tool message with empty string content converts to a function_call_output that still carries output ""; the field used to be dropped and OpenAI rejected the request with "Missing required parameter: 'input[N].output'" (#8568).
